name: Llama Prompt Guard 2
summary: Meta's small open-weight classifiers (86M and 22M) that flag prompt injection and jailbreak attempts in user input and untrusted content.
description: Binary benign/malicious labels; the 22M version (DeBERTa-xsmall) cuts latency and compute by about 75% versus 86M with minimal performance loss, per the model card. Used as LlamaFirewall's PromptGuard scanner. Gated weights under the Llama 4 Community License.
